cards.Dictionary Meaning (English): The fundamental, ineffable principle or way that underlies and governs the universe.
cards.Nuance (English): Implies a cosmic order that cannot be fully expressed in words.
cards.Sentence Translations (English): The Dao that can be spoken of is not the eternal Dao; the name that can be named is not the eternal name;
cards.Sentences: S道可道，非常道，名可名，非常名；

cards.Dictionary Meaning (English): A physical or metaphorical route taken by a person or thing.
cards.Nuance (English): May imply a journey or direction, but lacks the metaphysical connotation.
cards.Sentence Translations (English): The road is distant and cannot be reached.|The traveler advanced along the path.|The mountain trail is rugged and difficult to traverse.|This road leads to the city.
cards.Sentences: 道遠，不可至。|行者沿道而進。|山道險峻，難以通行。|此道通向城邑。
